situation: Five months in, your girlfriend says she's going night fishing, alone, with her sister's husband. She's never held a rod.

scenario.title: One Night, Fishing
scenario.setting: A cosy neighbourhood bar on a weeknight, two glasses on the table, new rubber boots in a shopping bag by her chair.
scenario.user_goal: Work out whether you're overreacting, and say what you feel without looking small.
user_knows: She has known him for almost twenty years
You haven't met her family yet

cast.name: Sophie
cast.appearance: Woman about 35, denim shirt, relaxed, laughing, beer in hand
cast.secret: The trip is really to plan a surprise for her sister's anniversary. She never says so in front of her sister
cast.reveal_when: You stop accusing and tell her you're uneasy
red_lines: Won't be told who she can see

cast.name: Clara
cast.appearance: Woman about 40, trench coat, surprised smile, arriving at the pub table
cast.goal: See who her sister is dating
cast.secret: She isn't bothered, but she never actually said yes to the trip
cast.reveal_when: You ask her how she feels, not what she allows

cast.name: Mark
cast.appearance: Man about 44, fleece vest, ruddy cheerful face, fishing hat, big laugh
cast.secret: He's already asked her not to tell anyone the location
cast.reveal_when: You ask him to invite you along

scenario.opening_line: Don't make that face. It's fishing. He's basically my brother.

events.description: Her sister turns up at the table: she was in the area.
events.shot: A woman in a trench coat stands at the pub table smiling, the younger woman looking up in surprise.

events.description: A big laugh from the door. Her brother-in-law, in his fishing hat.
events.shot: A ruddy man in a fishing hat joins the two women at the pub table with a loud laugh.

events.description: Her phone lights up on the table. She turns it over quickly.
events.shot: The woman in the denim shirt turns her glowing phone face down while the others look on.

success_criteria: Says what's bothering him without accusing
Finds out why they're really going

assets.basis: Adapted from a story someone really posted online. Names and details are changed.
